name: Shotfile: Screenshot Organizer
subtitle: Search & Clear Old Screenshots
promotionalText: Find any screenshot by the words in it. Shotfile sorts your screenshots into codes, tickets, receipts and chats, and spots the ones that are out of date.
description:
Screenshots pile up: a verification code, a boarding pass, an order confirmation, a chat you wanted to remember. Shotfile reads them on your iPhone so you can find any screenshot by the words in it, and clear the ones you no longer need.

SEARCH BY TEXT
Type a word you remember, like a booking code, a street name or a price, and Shotfile shows every screenshot that contains it, with the matching line highlighted.

SORTED FOR YOU
Screenshots are grouped into Codes & Logins, Tickets & Passes, Receipts & Orders, Chats, Maps & Directions, Posts & Links, Notes & Articles and Pictures.

OUT-OF-DATE SCREENSHOTS
Shotfile spots one-time codes that are more than two days old and tickets or passes whose dates have passed, and puts them in one list so you can review and delete them together. Upcoming tickets stay put.

COPY AND SHARE TEXT
Open any screenshot to see the text Shotfile found, select part of it, copy it all, or share it.

LIVE PHOTOS TO STILLS
Every Live Photo carries a short video. Turn the ones you don't need moving into normal photos: Shotfile keeps the picture, its date, location, favorite flag and albums, and drops only the video.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Duplicate photos and similar shots, with the best one marked to keep
• Large videos, biggest first
• Swipe Review: go through screenshots one at a time, left to delete, right to keep
• A running total of the storage you've freed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Text recognition runs on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework. Nothing is uploaded, and there are no accounts, ads or tracking. Nothing is deleted until you choose it and confirm, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

SHOTFILE PREMIUM
Reading, sorting, search, copying text and Swipe Review are free. The free plan deletes or converts up to 20 items a day; Premium removes the daily limit.
• Monthly: $3.99 per month
• Yearly: $29.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://jimtarfas.github.io/shotfile-site/privacy.html
reviewNotes:
Shotfile is a screenshot organizer. It reads the text in the user's screenshots on the device (Apple Vision text recognition), sorts them by kind (codes, tickets and passes, receipts, chats, directions, posts, notes, pictures), makes them searchable by text, and flags screenshots that are out of date: one-time codes older than two days and tickets whose dates have all passed (dates are read from the text). It also converts Live Photos to stills, keeping the photo, date, location, favorite and albums. Nothing leaves the device and nothing is deleted without the system confirmation.

How to test:
1. Allow photo access.
2. The home screen shows the screenshot count and the categories once reading finishes.
3. Type a word from any screenshot in the search field.
4. Open a screenshot to see and copy its text.
5. 'Ready to Clear' appears when there are old one-time code messages or past tickets. A screenshot of a verification code message dated more than two days ago will show there.
6. Photo library > Live Photos to Stills lists Live Photos taken with the Camera.

Subscriptions: the Premium screen opens once after first launch and from the crown button on the home screen; it also opens when the free plan's 20 deletions or conversions per day are used up. It shows both plans with full pricing, the 3-day free trial on the yearly plan, Restore Purchases, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. No account or login is needed.
